pages.setting: An emptying town square at closing time, with a slide, swing, fountain, rooftop pigeons, and perimeter fence.
pages.mainAction: The child points beneath the shadowless slide while Uri notices a long dark ribbon fluttering beyond the fence.
pages.lighting: Soft dusk light with lengthening evening shadows.

pages.setting: A sidewalk beside shrubs, a bench, parked cars, sun-warmed stones, and a bakery entrance.
pages.mainAction: Uri bounds after the windblown shadow as the child lifts an old wicker basket with clean cardboard from beside the bakery.
pages.lighting: Fading dusk mixed with warm light from the bakery.

pages.setting: A lit bus stop where overlapping shadows from a post, bin, and planter gather on the pavement.
pages.mainAction: The child kneels beside the shadow pile and studies pale hairs on the soft ribbon while Uri releases the round bin shadow.
pages.lighting: Cool evening under a bright bus-stop lamp.

pages.setting: A small sheltered garden between two buildings, with a low wall, jasmine bush, fence, and moon above.
pages.mainAction: The child carefully lifts one corner of the shadow, revealing a tiny kitten curled beneath its layered folds as Uri approaches softly.
pages.lighting: Gentle moonlight filtered through jasmine leaves.
continuityAnchors: same slide shadow with pale hairs

pages.setting: The pocket garden beside its low wall and a small building air vent.
pages.mainAction: Uri discovers warm air flowing from the low vent while the child tests it with an outstretched hand; the kitten remains under the shadow nearby.
pages.lighting: Cool moonlight contrasted with a soft warm glow near the vent.
continuityAnchors: kitten wrapped in the slide shadow

pages.setting: The sheltered corner of the pocket garden beside the warm air vent.
pages.mainAction: The kitten crawls into the sideways basket lined with cardboard and dry leaves as the shadow loosens onto the path, leaving one small corner over it.
pages.lighting: Warm vent light against the cool night garden.
continuityAnchors: same wicker basket turned on its side
same clean cardboard used as flooring

pages.setting: The town square reached along the sidewalk past the bakery and bus stop.
pages.mainAction: The long shadow sweeps over the fence and settles precisely beneath the slide while the child and Uri watch it become whole again.
pages.lighting: Clear moonlit night with a final warm trace from the bakery.
continuityAnchors: most of the shadow returned from the kitten shelter

pages.setting: The pocket garden under a broad night sky, with rooftops, trees, and the distant square beyond.
pages.mainAction: The child and yawning Uri look back while heading home as the kitten sleeps in the warm basket beneath the small breathing corner of shadow.
pages.lighting: Quiet moonlight spread across the garden, rooftops, and square, with gentle warmth at the vent.
continuityAnchors: same basket shelter with cardboard and dry leaves
small corner of the slide shadow remains over the kitten
slide shadow restored beneath the distant slide
